{{Recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|All-purpose flour]]

* Water
* [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|Vegetable oil]] 

== Procedure ==
# Take 2 handfuls of flour and put in a bowl. Using a spoon, make a well in the middle.
# Fill the well halfway with vegetable oil and the other half with water.
# [[Cookbook:Folding|Fold]] in the flour and mix until a [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]] comes together in the bowl.
# Let rest for 1 hour.
# Divide dough into 4 parts. Taking 1 piece of dough, flatten it with your palms and then stretch the dough until it is thin as a tissue.
# Cook on a pan or other hot surface until small to medium bubbles appear on the surface.
# Flip onto other side (with your hand or spatula) to let cook for 30–40 seconds more.
# Repeat cooking steps until all the dough is used up.
